name: Long March 2D/YZ-3
location_str: Launch Area 94 (SLS-2 / 603) @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation's 43rd launch of the year, 613th all time. 6th from Launch Area 94 (SLS-2 / 603) this year, 70 days since the last one. The 213th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year.
slot_b_text: Astronauts on the International Space Station witness 16 sunrises and sunsets every single day.
